title: Distinguish complete, gap and untrustworthy check results
preconditions: Use coveredSaga with all six implementation lines covered and no story path; separately use duplicate story IDs across features to make a report untrustworthy.

steps.action: Check implementation and stories against main.
steps.expected_result: The valid report returns coverage-gap exit 3.

steps.action: Check health for the duplicate-ID Saga.
steps.expected_result: The command errors as untrustworthy rather than returning a coverage-gap result.

expected_result: Exit 3 means a trustworthy report with an omission, not invalid input or an untrustworthy Saga.
